Steven M. Ellard, CPA

By the time your return gets filed in the spring, the year is already over. Whatever it says is a record of decisions made months earlier, and there isn't much anyone can do about it at that point.

That's the real difference between accountants. Not who fills the forms in faster, but whether anyone was looking at your numbers in September and October while the decisions were still open.

Your accountant files your taxes.
We plan them.
The difference shows up in April. But the work starts now. The moves that shrink a tax bill close on December 31.
